```python
    def compile_order(self, root):
        seen = {root}
        stack = [root]
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            for prereq in self.prereqs[node]:
                if prereq not in seen:
                    seen.add(prereq); stack.append(prereq)
        indegree = {n: len(self.prereqs[n]) for n in seen}
        heap = [n for n, d in indegree.items() if d == 0]
        heapify(heap)
        out = []
        while heap:
            node = heappop(heap); out.append(node)
            for dep in self.dependents[node]:
                if dep in indegree:
                    indegree[dep] -= 1
                    if indegree[dep] == 0: heappush(heap, dep)
        return out
```
